newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes at four-month low in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes at four-month low in afternoon.

text.p: Gold was fixed at $338.20 an ounce on Friday, the lowest fixing since February 12.
In the morning gold was fixed at $339.55, down from Thursday's afternoon level of $340.20, and then lost more ground after the New York market opened.
Bullion had been hovering around the $337-$338 support levels in the afternoon and was bid as low as $337.50 an ounce.
Light selling led by New York amid increasingly bearish sentiment helped push prices lower, dealers said.
At the previous low fixing on February 12, gold was set at $336.90, which was the lowest level since April 1993.
The other precious metals -- silver, platinum and palladium -- were little changed from Thursday's closing levels.
